 Monday's classes at the University of Delaware have been cancelled , as six people recover from Saturday's night's mass shooting on Main Street in Newark.
 University officials stress the decision not to hold classes Monday is not based on a current safety concern. Newark Police continue to indicate there is no ongoing threat to the community.
 But administrators say they want to give students, faculty, and staff time to rest, process, and connect with support.
 The university was already scheduled to be closed on Tuesday for Election Day, so classes will resume on Wednesday
 The school's Newark campus, including dining services, remain open.
 Counseling walk-in support will be available Monday from 9:00 AM-4:00 PM in Warner Hall, and TimelyCare is available 24/7. Faculty and staff can reach the Employee Assistance Program.
